entities.summary: Troy William Slaten is an American attorney and former child actor, best known for his work depicting Jerry Steiner on the series Parker Lewis Can't Lose, Michael Lacey on Cagney and Lacey, and Amp Ere in Superhuman Samurai Syber-Squad.
